<thought>By analyzing the pairwise resistance measurements, I identified a simple series chain that satisfies all values:
A‑X1 = 16.364 Ω, X1‑N_b1 = 5 Ω, N_b1‑N_b2 = 10 Ω, N_b2‑N_b3 = 15 Ω, N_b3‑B = 20 Ω.
These five resistors (R1…R5) placed in order from left (A) to right (B) reproduce every given measurement, including the intermediate node‑to‑node resistances. The required JSON therefore lists the resistor values and the connections between nodes.</thought>
<final_answer>{"resistors":{"R1":16.364,"R2":5.0,"R3":10.0,"R4":15.0,"R5":20.0},"connections":[["A","X1","R1"],["X1","N_b1","R2"],["N_b1","N_b2","R3"],["N_b2","N_b3","R4"],["N_b3","B","R5"]]}</final_answer>
